thread:
Leah CSM: Marlin Health asks for a temporary allowlist + APAC region routing for a staged pilot. Pilot window: 2026-05-12 02:00-05:00 UTC. They want 5% of traffic routed to APAC edge, and a soft quota bump to avoid hard throttles during the demo.
Ethan Net: Can do. Need their egress IPs and a contact for PoP verification. We prefer auto-revoke TTL 96h. Also confirm TLS fingerprint if they're doing mTLS.
Leah CSM: IPs: 52.196.10.0/24 and 203.120.0.0/18. TLS not required for demo; HTTPS only. Estimated sustained QPS 60, short bursts to 220 for up to 15m.
Ravi Ops: For routing: we can add a weighted traffic rule (apac:5%, eu/us:95%) and create a temporary route policy marlin-pilot-2026-05-12. Alerts: p95 latency >750ms or error rate >0.5% will auto-failover to eu/us.
Nina CS: This account is mid-onboard, flagged for renewal touchpoint in 45 days. They need latency screenshots and runbook to present to stakeholders. Please make sure we collect perf metrics and example trace ids.
Ivy ML: Suggest model-fallback: route to quantized-8bit for non-interactive paths during spikes. Add rule: if cost_per_1k_tokens > $0.60 or tail_latency >500ms, switch to redwood-q3-quant. We can pre-warm KV cache.
Ethan Net: Allowlist snippet ready for edge push (auto-expire):
```
- name: marlin-temp-allow
  cidrs:
    - 52.196.10.0/24
    - 203.120.0.0/18
  ports: [443]
  description: "Marlin Health pilot - demo window only"
  expires_at: 2026-05-16T02:00:00Z
```
Ethan Net: I'll file the infra change and request EM sign-off.
edge-bot: ACL marlin-temp-allow queued for staging validation (id: acl-9b4). No conflicts found.
Ravi Ops: Quota config proposal: account O-22177 soft_quota 200rps, hard_quota 500rps during window, autorevoke 2026-05-12T05:30:00Z. Will attach runbook: paging thresholds and rollback steps.
Nina CS: Please add a short enablement checklist for Marlin: warmup tokens, sample prompts, test vectors, how to interpret p50/p95 graphs. I'll run the pre-demo call.
Lara AM: Adding FYI - renewal team watching. If pilot hits SLOs we will propose Dedicated evaluation. Capture cost delta too.
Leah CSM: Dry run scheduled 2026-05-11 23:00 UTC. Action items: Ethan push ACL + infra PR, Ravi apply quota & route policy, Ivy add quantized fallback and KV warmup instructions, Nina send enablement doc.
Ethan Net: ACK - posting infra PR link after staging validate.
Ravi Ops: ACK - will enable weighted routing and attach escalation matrix.
Ivy ML: Canary for model-fallback created in staging. Will promote after dry-run.
Nina CS: Sent enablement checklist to Marlin SRE and booked the dry-run slot.
Leah CSM: Thanks team — priority: no hard throttles during demo and clean auto-revoke after window. Tagging @Lara AM for commercial visibility. :white_check_mark:
